description: Commercial real-estate and lease clause taxonomy for domain-aware retrieval.

entries.text: Commercial lease economics clause: establishes base rent, gross rent, or triple-net (NNN) structure and rent adjustment mechanics.
CAM and operating expenses clause: allocates common area maintenance, taxes, insurance, and reconciliations.
Tenant improvement allowance clause: defines landlord contribution, approval process, and disbursement conditions for improvements.
Assignment and subletting restrictions clause: regulates transfers, consent rights, recapture options, and profit-sharing.

standard_language_patterns: tenant shall not assign or sublet without consent

entries.text: Holdover clause: sets rent premium and liability when tenant remains in possession after lease expiration.
Renewal option clause: defines extension windows, notice deadlines, rent reset formulas, and conditions to exercise options.

standard_language_patterns: tenant may renew for an additional term
